title: Sometimes by Step
lyrics: Verse 1:
[D]Sometimes the [A/D]night was beautiful.[D] Sometimes the [A/D]sky was so far away.
[G/B]Sometimes it seemed to stoop so [Asus]close you could [A7]touch it, but your heart would [F#m]break.
Sometimes the mor[G]ning came too [F#m]soon. Sometimes the [G]day could be so [G/B]hard.
There was so [A]much work left to [G2]do, but so much you'd [Em7]already [G/A]done.
Chorus 1:
[A]Oh [D]God, You are my [A/C#]God, [A] and [G/B]I will [Asus]ever [A]praise [D]You.
[A7]Oh [D]God, You are my [A/C#]God, [A] and [G/B]I will [Asus]ever [A]praise [D]You.
I will [Bm]seek You in the mor[A]ning,
And I will [G]learn to walk in Your [Em7]ways.
And [D]step by step, You'll [A/C#]lead me,[A]
And I will [G/B]follow You [Asus]all of [A]my [D]days.
Verse 2:
[D]Sometimes I [A/D]think of Abraham,[D] how one star he [A/D]saw had been lit for me.
[G/B]He was a stranger in this [Asus]land, and I am [A7]that no less than [F#m]he.
And on this [G]road to righteous[F#m]ness, sometimes the [G]climb can be so [G/B]steep;
I may [A]falter in my [G2]steps, but never [Em7]beyond Your [G/A]reach.
Bridge 1:
And I will [Bm]follow You all of my [Asus]days.[A]
And I will [Em7]follow You all of my [C]days.[G2]
And [D/A]step by step, You'll [A]lead me,
And I will [G/B]follow You [G/A]all of my [D]days.[A/D]
